A Typst document that imports a package now previews. More at
[www.malgel.com](https://www.malgel.com).

## Fixed

- **Typst packages resolve, on every platform.** A `.typ` file that imports a
  package (`#import "@preview/touying:0.7.4": *`) failed to open, reporting
  only that a file was not found at a `typst.toml` next to the document —
  because the preview read the package's path from the document's own folder.
  Packages are read from the folders the `typst` command keeps them in, which
  are the platform's data folder, then its cache folder, and
  `TYPST_PACKAGE_PATH` / `TYPST_PACKAGE_CACHE_PATH` override them the same way
  the command does. A deck built on a package such as Touying or CeTZ previews
  the pages it would build.
- A package that is not installed is now reported by its name, with the way to
  fetch it, instead of a path next to the document that could never hold it.

## Downloads

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS 11+ (Apple silicon) | `Malgel-0.1.12-macos-arm64.dmg`: open it and drag Malgel to Applications |
| Windows 10+ | `Malgel-0.1.12-windows-x64-setup.exe` (installer) or `Malgel-0.1.12-windows-x64.zip` (portable) |
| Linux x86_64 | `Malgel-0.1.12-x86_64.AppImage` (`chmod +x` it, then run it) or `malgel-0.1.12-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |

The macOS app is signed ad hoc and not notarized, so Gatekeeper blocks it after download: right-click it and choose Open once, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Malgel.app`. The Windows files are unsigned: SmartScreen may warn, and **More info → Run anyway** gets past it. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists every file's checksum.
